source_photo_deduplication.rule: Multiple responsive image variants (hero.webp, card.webp, thumbnail.webp) sharing identical source photo directory hash collapse into exactly 1 domain photo asset.
source_photo_deduplication.hash_extractor_pattern: Extract parent directory hash of image URL (e.g. /static/images/places/place_bbsr_001/06a456469886/hero.webp -> 06a456469886)

verified_image_gate.rule: NO VERIFIED IMAGE = NO PUBLIC STOCK PHOTO. Places pending photo verification display neutral cultural sandstone typography cards.

unverified_presentation.android: Box with Sandstone/surfaceContainerHigh background + category + Odia script + place name
unverified_presentation.ios: FallbackCulturalBanner with ColorTokens.sandstoneLight + Odia typography + badge_pending

photo_count_indicator.behavior: When place has verified photos, badge displays singular ('1 Verified Photo') or plural ('N Verified Photos') accurately reflecting deduplicated source photos count, never raw variant URL count.
